# Companion materials {#sec-companion-materials}

Companion references should remain useful when a reader has only a printed
page, when an EPUB reader does not expose arbitrary packaged files, or when a
website can offer a direct download. Each entry below comes from one checked
registry and keeps the same stable identity across those presentations.

## Download manifest {#sec-companion-download}

{{< alk-companion asset-half-adder-project-pack >}}

For a public release, copy each registered file to its declared release-package
location without renaming it, or add a durable HTTPS URL while retaining the
fallback path. A changed byte requires a new checksum; a compatibility or
content change requires a deliberate semantic version update.
